overall_goal: Manage the cooking process by seasoning and adding tomatoes to the wok, logging nutritional values, and cleaning the kitchen.

goals.description: Clean up food scraps from the counter and floor.
goals.rationale: The person wipes food scraps off the counter and floor and throws them in the trash.

goals.description: Stir the ingredients in the wok.
goals.rationale: The person opens the wok, mixes the ingredients with a spatula, and puts the spatula down.

goals.description: Retrieve a spice jar and log its nutritional value using a phone.
goals.rationale: The person finds a spice jar in the cabinet and uses their phone to scan its barcode and record its nutritional value.

goals.description: Season the ingredients in the wok and stir.
goals.rationale: The person scoops spices into the wok and mixes them into the ingredients with a spatula.
The person rinses the small spoon under the tap and places it in the dish rack.

goals.description: Log the nutritional value of the seasoning using a phone.
goals.rationale: The person uses their phone to update measurements and record the nutritional value of the seasoning.

goals.description: Open the wok and stir the ingredients.
goals.rationale: The person removes the pan from the wok and mixes the ingredients with a spatula.

goals.description: Add canned tomatoes to the wok and stir.
goals.rationale: The person pours a can of tomatoes into the wok and mixes it in with a spatula.

goals.description: Retrieve jarred tomato sauce, add it to the wok, and stir.
goals.rationale: The person grabs a jar of tomato sauce, empties it into the wok, cleans the jar's edges, and stirs the wok.

goals.description: Rinse and recycle the empty tomato sauce can.
goals.rationale: The person washes the empty tomato sauce can under the tap and throws it in the recycling bin.

goals.description: Dry the jar of tomato sauce and store it in the refrigerator.
goals.rationale: The person dries the jar of tomato sauce with a paper towel and places it in the fridge.

goals.description: Wash the coffee mug and its lid.
goals.rationale: The person cleans the coffee mug and its lid with a sponge and running water, then places them in the drying rack.
The person places the spoon in the sink, washes it with a sponge, and puts it in the drying rack.

goals.description: Clean the kitchen counter and put away measuring cups.
goals.rationale: The person sprays and wipes down the kitchen counter and stacks measuring cups to store them in a drawer.

goals.description: Lower the stove temperature and stir the ingredients in the wok.
goals.rationale: The person opens the wok, turns down the stove heat, and mixes the ingredients.
